content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DMHO Jogulamba Gadwal Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the official website at gadwal.telangana.gov.in . Fill in the application form completely with all required details. Enclose self-attested copies of all required certificates along with the application form and demand draft. Submit the filled-in application form in person or through registered post to the District Medical & Health Officer, (IDOC) Gadwal Jogulamba District. Ensure the application reaches the office on or before 13-10-2026 by 05:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: S.S.C/Dated of Birth Certificate issued by the Competent Authority of the Government, for proof of age. Intermediate or 10+2 examinations. Qualifying Examination Pass Certificate. Marks Memos of all the years (qualifying examination). Registration Certificate of respective Councils. Permanent two wheeler driving license with up to date (for applicable posts). Certificate course in computer operations (minimum 2 months). Latest Community Certificate/EWC Certificate/Ex-Service Men/NCC/ Physically Handicapped, whichever is applicable, issued by the Competent Authority. Study certificates for the years from 1st class to 10th class and in case of Private study residence certificate from the Tahsildar /MRO concerned. PH certificate in respect of candidates claiming reservation under PH Quota. Relevant certificates in respect to candidates claiming Ex-service Men Quota. Registration Certificate from the concerned Medical Council/ Nursing Council/ Para Medical Board / Other relevant authority. Photograph duly pasted on the application form. DD for Rs.500/- or Rs.300/- in favour of DM&HO, Jogulamba Gadwal district.

faq.question: Q1. What is DMHO Jogulamba Gadwal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification issued by the District Medical and Health Office, Jogulamba Gadwal District to fill 49 temporary posts under NHM, AYUSH, and NTEP on a contract or outsourcing basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: A total of 49 vacancies are available across various posts including Lab Technician, Staff Nurse, Medical Officer, Pharmacist, Physician, and others.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for DMHO Jogulamba Gadwal Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 13-10-2026 till 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline, either in person or through registered post, to the District Medical & Health Officer, (IDOC) Gadwal Jogulamba District.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 44 years as on 01.07.2026, with age relaxations applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs.500/- for OC and OBC candidates, and Rs.300/- for SCs, STs, and PH candidates, payable via Demand Draft in favour of DM&HO, Jogulamba Gadwal district.

faq.question: Q7. Are these permanent government posts?
faq.answer: No, the posts notified are not permanent or regular Government posts and are purely temporary for a period of one year or till actual need ceases.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates can download the application form from the official website at gadwal.telangana.gov.in.
